ops.title: gt 1.8.6 stack metadata is SQLite (.git/.graphite_metadata.db), not refs/branch-metadata
ops.body: Binary-verified on a live gt 1.8.6 run (2026-07-23, scratch repo): Graphite CLI no longer writes `refs/branch-metadata/<branch>` blob refs (the open-source-era/freephite format). Metadata lives in `.git/.graphite_metadata.db`, a Kysely-migrated SQLite3 db, table `branch_metadata(branch_name PK, parent_branch_name, parent_branch_revision, last_submitted_version, state, children, branch_revision, validation_result, parent_head_revision)`. Trunk row: NULL parent, validation_result 'TRUNK'. `parent_branch_revision` keeps its old checkpoint semantics (parent tip at track time — stale after restacks; compute live merge-bases instead). `.git/.graphite_repo_config` JSON with `trunk` (plus a newer `trunks` array) is unchanged and still the trunk source. `.graphite_pr_info` is a separate JSON file. Robust read path: open the db read-only, SELECT only branch_name + parent_branch_name (schema is migration-versioned; extra columns appear over time). Consumed by cc-interact vcs/graphite.go (DetectStack/CaptureStack).
